<details id="pc-audio" class="hnls-guide-disclosure"><summary>Play Spotify / Pandora from a Windows PC<small>Download the sender, select PC audio, then play music on Windows.</small></summary><section class="card" aria-labelledby="pcStreamHeading"><div class="card-body">
    <h2 id="pcStreamHeading" class="h4">Play Spotify or Pandora from Windows</h2>
    <p>Play Spotify or Pandora on your Windows PC. HNLS receives the sound, plays it through the selected Pi audio output, and makes the lights react live.</p>
    <div class="d-flex flex-wrap" style="gap:10px">
        <a class="btn btn-outline-primary" href="/api/music/pc-stream/sender">Download the PC sender</a>
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" id="pcStreamStart">Use PC audio</button>
        <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-secondary" id="pcStreamStop">Stop PC audio</button>
    </div>
    <p class="mt-3 mb-2">Extract the ZIP on Windows and double-click <strong>Start-HNLS-Audio.cmd</strong>. Then play music. Both computers must be on the same reachable network.</p>
    <p id="pcStreamStatus" role="status" aria-live="polite">Checking PC audio…</p>
    <details><summary>Playback and privacy details</summary><p class="small mt-2">The sender captures all sound on the default Windows playback device, including alerts. Spotify/Pandora controls stay on your PC; uploaded-song timed moments do not run for live streams. The sender contains a private pairing key—keep it off GitHub. LAN audio is authenticated but not encrypted. Changing the Windows playback device requires restarting the sender. Schedule boundaries still control HNLS. Streaming is selected manually after a Pi reboot. Advanced Studio has a separate audio path.</p></details>
</div></section>

</details><details id="show-hours" class="hnls-guide-disclosure"><summary>Set automatic show hours<small>Choose days, start time and stop time.</small></summary><div><section class="hnls-schedule" aria-labelledby="hnlsScheduleTitle">
<p class="hnls-kicker">AUTOMATIC SHOW HOURS</p><h2 id="hnlsScheduleTitle">When should the show run?</h2>
<form id="hnlsScheduleForm">
<label class="hnls-schedule-toggle"><input type="checkbox" id="hnlsScheduleEnabled"> Enable automatic show schedule</label>
<fieldset class="hnls-schedule-days"><legend>Days the show starts</legend><label><input type="checkbox" id="hnlsScheduleDay0"> Mon</label><label><input type="checkbox" id="hnlsScheduleDay1"> Tue</label><label><input type="checkbox" id="hnlsScheduleDay2"> Wed</label><label><input type="checkbox" id="hnlsScheduleDay3"> Thu</label><label><input type="checkbox" id="hnlsScheduleDay4"> Fri</label><label><input type="checkbox" id="hnlsScheduleDay5"> Sat</label><label><input type="checkbox" id="hnlsScheduleDay6"> Sun</label></fieldset><div class="hnls-schedule-times"><label>Start time<input type="time" id="hnlsScheduleStart" required></label><label>Stop time<input type="time" id="hnlsScheduleEnd" required></label><label>Time zone<input id="hnlsScheduleTimezone" list="hnlsTimezones" placeholder="America/Chicago" required><datalist id="hnlsTimezones"><option value="America/Chicago"><option value="America/New_York"><option value="America/Denver"><option value="America/Los_Angeles"><option value="UTC"></datalist></label></div>
<p class="small text-muted">At the start: shuffled playlist and the saved Light Show on all configured outputs. At the stop: music stops and lights turn off. The Pis stay on for the next show. For overnight hours, days refer to the start day.</p>
<p class="small text-muted">Saved schedules run with the browser closed. Enabling during show hours starts immediately. Disabling stops a scheduled show. Manual controls remain available; the next schedule boundary takes control again.</p>
<button type="submit" id="hnlsScheduleSave" class="btn btn-primary" disabled>Save show hours</button><p id="hnlsScheduleClock" class="small"></p><p id="hnlsScheduleStatus" role="status" aria-live="polite">Loading show hours…</p></form></section>
